title: In Alaska, Ranked-Choice Ballots Are Unlikely to Be Enough for Dan Sullivan
summary: An analysis shows Mary Peltola is likely to keep her lead in the Senate race in part because of ballots she’d accumulate in ranked-choice tabulation from supporters of the other Dan Sullivan.
